svg.aria-label: Bandgap of afe_ref_tr: PMOS mirror MP0 to MP4 and MPN (8/4); PMOS-input op-amp MA1, MA2 (40/4) with mirror MN1, MN2 (8/8), CCB and output device MN3; diodes D1 (1x), D2 (8x) with R1; output branch MP3 into the PTAT string R2B plus fifteen 1.4325 kOhm segments to D3; the 16:1 NMOS trim mux selects a tap as vtap, filtered by CFL; start-up MS1 to MS3
svg.text: VBG(tap k) = VBE(D3) + I_PTAT · (84.04 kΩ + k · 1.4325 kΩ), I_PTAT = Vt · ln 8 / R1 ≈ 5 µA; code 1000b = 95.5 kΩ = 1.1866 V (tm, 27 °C).
The tap changes only the PTAT term, so trimming VBG to its target also corrects the temperature coefficient of a VBE spread. nb (MNB, 5 µA) biases every NMOS tail and sink.
Disabled: MBG_OFF pulls pg to VDD33, MBG_O1 grounds o1, MSO grounds sg, MNBO grounds nb.
